# Serial (online)

<!-- Generated by `npm run profiles`; edit scripts/profiles.ts or the guidance files, not this. -->

Measured on 500 of LC's online serials. A field is **shown** when 50% or more of them have it, and **suggested** at 10% to 50%, unless an override says otherwise. An existing record also gets a row for every value it has, whatever its tier. [All kinds](README.md) · [The rules](../which-fields.md)

## Defined by

A record is a serial (online) when its Work's type is `Serial`, or its issuance (`bf:issuance`) is `serl`, and its only carrier (`bf:carrier`) is `cr` (online resource). Once you choose serial (online), a new record holds: Instance type `Electronic`, Instance `bf:issuance` `serl`, Instance `bf:carrier` `cr`, Work type `Text`.

## Overrides

None: every tier here comes from the measured share.

## Available through Add field

Properties some of LC's online serials have that the sections don't offer: under 10% of them, or moved here by an override. Add field offers these and every other BIBFRAME property, with their shares.

`bf:summary` 5%, `bf:place` 5%, `bf:responsibilityStatement` 4%, `bflc:governmentPubType` 4%, `bf:accompaniedBy` 4%, `bf:manufactureStatement` 1%, `bf:supplementaryContent` 1%

## Never offered

Record-keeping and structure, whatever their share: `bf:adminMetadata`, `bf:instanceOf`, `bf:hasInstance`, `bflc:aap`, `bflc:aap-normalized`, `dcterms:isPartOf`.
